Date Sept. 22, 1937

(印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY 8098 H. Q. D. Station, 37 Date: Sept. 22, 1937)

REPORT

Subject Dispute concerning the nationality of an alleged traitor.

Made by D.I. Glover Forwarded by C.D.I. Prince

Sir,

During the morning of the 22nd Sept. 1937, Inspr. Shiro Naito, attached to H.I.J.M.'s Foreign Office, at present stationed at Shanghai, called at Police Headquarters where he produced Passport No. 0275942 issued by the local Consul General showing that the detained man and his wife are Japanese subjects.

Acting on instructions received, the undersigned interviewed the M./A., Mr. R. T. Bryan Jr., when the reasons for the non-execution of Warrants Nos. 2577 and 2580 issued by the 1st S.S.D.C., at the request of the Shanghai Martial Law Commander's Headquarters, were explained.

Mr. Bryan stated that in view of the documentary evidence produced by H.I.J.M.'s Consular Authorities, the S.M.P. had no option but to release the man.

This decision was communicated to the Shanghai Martial Law Commander's representative Mr. Shi Bang Yi (许鹏飞), who requested that photostatic copies of the passport and documents issued by the Japanese Consulate be handed over to him as proof of the wanted man's nationality. Arrangements have been made, with the approval of the D.C. (Crime), to let the Chinese Authorities have the necessary proof, providing that they make their application in the usual manner.

Following instructions received, the detained man was handed over into the custody of Inspr. Shiro Naito, who has undertaken to see that this man and his family are removed to a place of safety.

The warrants issued by the 1st S.S.D.C. have been endorsed accordingly and returned to the Judicial Police Office.

报告

事由：关于一名涉嫌汉奸国籍之争议。

报告人：侦缉督察葛洛华（音译） 呈转人：总侦缉督察普林斯（音译）

长官：

1937年9月22日上午，现驻上海的大日本帝国警务处（原文如此，指外务省）内藤城（音译）督察造访警务处总部，并出示了当地总领事馆签发的第 0275942 号护照，证明被拘留男子及其妻子为日本臣民。

根据接获的指示，签字人晤见了工部局法律顾问陆朋（R. T. Bryan Jr.）先生，期间就未执行由上海第一特区地方法院应上海警备司令部请求签发的第 2577 号和第 2580 号逮捕证之原因进行了说明。

陆朋先生表示，鉴于大日本帝国领事当局出示的书面证据，上海工部局警务处别无选择，只能将该人释放。

此项决定已通报给上海警备司令部代表许鹏飞先生（原文化名“Shi Bang Yi”，括号内汉字“许鹏飞”），彼请求将日本领事馆签发的护照及文件影印件移交予彼，以作为被通缉者国籍之证明。经助理处长（刑事）批准，已作出安排，只要中国当局按常规程序提出申请，即可向其提供必要之证明。

根据接获的指示，该被拘留人已被移交给内藤城（音译）督察看管，内藤已承诺负责将该人及其家属转移至安全地点。

第一特区地方法院签发的逮捕证已作相应批注，并已退还司法警察科。

Detective Inspector Hsu Bang Fei (許鵬飛) and Detective
Constable Zung Kving Piau (戎金標) attached to the Detective
Corps of the Shanghai Martial Law Commander's Headquarters came
to this branch at 12 noon 21st instant, and requested assistance
to arrest and search the house of a person named Soo Dzian San
(蘇垣山) of 4 Hwa Kee Avenue who they stated, was wanted by
the Shanghai Martial Law Commander's Headquarters on a charge
of committing an act with intent to injure the Republic of China.
Warrants No. 2579 and 2580 for arrest and search respectively,
issued by Judge Dzien (錢) of the Shanghai Special District
Court at the request of the Shanghai Martial Law Commander's
Headquarters, were duly produced.
Detectives attached to Bubbling Well Station together
with detectives from this branch proceeded with the representa-
tives of the Chinese Authorities to Room 1, No. 4, Hwakee Avenue
where a man named So Kwa-bo (蘇火土) was identified by Detective
Inspector Hsu Bang Fei as being the person mentioned in the
warrant. This individual upon being questioned claimed to
be a Formosan Subject but as he could produce no documentary
evidence in proof of his assertion, he was requested to accompany
the party to Bubbling Well Station, to which he raised no object-
ion. His room was locked and the key taken to Bubbling Well
Station, two detectives being posted in the passage with ins-
tructions to permit no one to remove or destroy anything in
either of the two rooms occupied by So Kwa-bo and his family.
According to a statement subsequently taken from him, So Kwa-
bo was born at Datekyaku-Hori, Taichu Province, Formosa (Taiwan)

Medical College where he graduated in 1916 with the degree of

他承认大约两年前，他在南京卫生局登记其医院时，自称是日本人，但他声称这样做是出于商业原因。

该男子无法出示护照或身份证，因为他声称在访问台湾后，已于大约两年前将上述证件交还给了大日本帝国驻南京领事馆。这是按照对居住在中国的台湾人的指示办理的。

他于1937年8月3日撤离南京，乘坐民船来到上海。他没有申请发还护照，因为他认为随身携带此类证件旅行并不安全。他与妻子、七个孩子、一名女婿和一个孙辈到达上海后，前往外滩大饭店（Bund Municipal Hotel），在那里
